title: See the price first. A failed run costs nothing.

sentences: The price is on the button before anything starts.
You see it before you press start.
Sixty credits a minute of finished video.
A five minute video is quoted at three hundred credits.
The credits are held when the run starts.
Set aside, so it is not spent on anything else.
You never pay more than the quote.
You are charged for what it actually used.
Every held credit comes back on its own.
Pay for what you make. Never for a failure.
Every hold, charge and return is in your credit history.

scenes.big: Type your topic. See the plan.
sentences: Type your own topic at nightshift-ai dot studio, and see the plan.
One hundred free credits. No card.
